reports.title: The Ceasefire That Isn't
reports.subtitle: Trump called Iran's peace proposal garbage. Iran called the US terms surrender. Brent crude hit $104. Nobody's blinking.

reports.title: Pump Relief as Political Triage
reports.subtitle: Gas hit $4.52. Trump wants to kill the gas tax. Congress needs to pass it. The Highway Trust Fund will pay.

reports.title: The Summit Without a Spine
reports.subtitle: Trump flies to Beijing Tuesday. Both sides want stability. Neither side can say what they actually need from the other.

reports.title: Three Days of Quiet, Then Drones on Kyiv
reports.subtitle: Trump's 72-hour Ukraine ceasefire expired at midnight. Russia struck residential buildings in Kyiv by 3:35 AM.

reports.title: The Chip Lab on National Television
reports.subtitle: Beijing showed Huawei's secret semiconductor research lab on prime-time TV three days before Trump lands. This was a message, not a documentary.
